summary: First runtime candidate in which every binary is rebuildable from committed source plus archived, checksummed, GPG-verified upstream inputs. No component depends on an artifact of unknown provenance.
validation: The runtime directory was built twice and is byte-for-byte identical across both passes.
The initramfs was built twice and is byte-for-byte identical across both passes.
Every owned Go binary rebuilds from committed source to its exact pinned gate digest.
The pairing agent rebuilds deterministically to its repinned gate digest.
All four upstream Bluetooth sources are archived, checksum-matched to P1-045, and GPG-verified where upstream publishes signatures.
All host suites pass: MCU interface, DSP interface, provisioning, and the native platform harness.
The v10 image has not been booted.
corrections: The donor rootfs for packaging is the OTA2 83_members rootfs, not the phase3 stockroot. The LED animation manifest gate caught an incorrect donor selection: stockroot carries 28 lights assets, the reviewed set carries 8.

PAIRING_AGENT_SHA256 was repinned from ae60d800... to faaba0eb.... The prior value matched no archived artifact and its toolchain was never recorded, so it could not be satisfied by any available input.
safety: Writable raw MTD nodes are removed; only /dev/reinvoke-nand-ro mode 0400 remains.
Automatic physical unmute requires a live BlueALSA PCM-data lease whose worker TID matches both ALSA owner_pid and the expected executable.
NAND persistence and boot-slot work remain explicitly excluded.
